=== DOCS-TRUTH (WebFetch 2026-06-08) ===
• docs.getdbt.com/reference/resource-configs/trino-configs:
  - dbt-trino supports SNAPSHOTS (separately listed from materializations).
  - Snapshot-specific dbt-trino gotcha: Iceberg connector does not support default `TIMESTAMP(3) WITH TIME ZONE`; override with a `trino__current_timestamp()` macro returning `current_timestamp(6)`.
  - Supported materializations: `table`, `view`, `incremental`, `materialized_view` (the trino-configs page lists these). `ephemeral` is a dbt-core universal materialization that works on every adapter (not specific to dbt-trino).
• docs.getdbt.com/reference/resource-configs/snapshot_meta_column_names:
  - Four ALWAYS-PRESENT defaults: `dbt_scd_id`, `dbt_updated_at`, `dbt_valid_from`, `dbt_valid_to`.
  - `dbt_is_deleted` is CONDITIONAL — added only when `hard_deletes='new_record'` is configured.
  - `dbt_updated_at` semantics: for `strategy='timestamp'`, mirrors the source `updated_at` value; for `strategy='check'` WITHOUT an `updated_at` override, is the SNAPSHOT RUN TIME (current_timestamp); for `strategy='check'` WITH an optional `updated_at` config, uses that source column (same as timestamp strategy).
• docs.getdbt.com/reference/resource-properties/freshness + docs.getdbt.com/reference/commands/source + docs.getdbt.com/docs/deploy/source-freshness:
  - `freshness:` block under `config:` on a source (or per-table) with `warn_after: {count, period}` + `error_after: {count, period}`, period in {minute, hour, day} only.
  - `loaded_at_field:` REQUIRED on dbt-trino (warehouse-metadata fallback only on Snowflake/Redshift/BigQuery 1.7.3+/Databricks Fusion).
  - `dbt source freshness` is its OWN command, NOT part of `dbt run` / `dbt build`. State file: `target/sources.json` (NOT `manifest.json`).
  - No `--check-freshness` / `--skip-stale-sources` / `--freshness` CLI flag exists. Gate freshness operationally with a separate CI stage.
• docs.getdbt.com/docs/build/seeds + docs.getdbt.com/reference/project-configs/seed-paths:
  - Default seed directory: `seeds/` (since dbt 1.0, Dec 2021). Pre-1.0 was `data/`; that is stale.
  - `dbt seed` command loads CSVs as warehouse tables via CTAS. `dbt build` includes seeds in DAG; `dbt run` does NOT include seeds.
  - `+column_types` override under `seeds:` block in `dbt_project.yml` for type pins.
  - Reference via `{{ ref('seed_name') }}` — argument is CSV basename WITHOUT extension.
• trino.io/docs/467/connector/iceberg.html + iceberg.apache.org/docs/latest/:
  - Trino 467 has NO `SET STORAGE TIER` ALTER form, NO `storage_tier` / `storage_class` table property, NO `iceberg.storage-tier.*` catalog property family.
  - Iceberg spec has NO storage-tier concept on data files. Movement is the object store's job (MinIO `mc ilm` on this stack).
  - `expire_snapshots` (table procedure / ALTER TABLE EXECUTE) is the retention mechanism that lets cold-tier files actually be reclaimed.
• MinIO docs (docs.min.io/enterprise/aistor-object-store/administration/object-lifecycle-management/):
  - `mc ilm tier add` + `mc ilm rule add --transition-days N --transition-tier <TIER>` — age-based transition only.
  - NO `--transition-access-days` / `--last-accessed-days` / access-pattern-aware mode. Trigger is creation age, period.
